{"notes": "Visit 3, left at 4:00. Table: the tail is now closed. The outline is one continuous dark loop from the nose, around the tail curl near (27,5), down the right side at x~29 and back along the bottom to the start. Nothing is pale, so it is all connected. The only worry is the right side around (29,10-12), where dominoes look crowded or overlapping. That is where the two lines met, and it could topple unevenly. I don't know who placed which domino, so I credit no one for placement.

Leo: Kept coordinating well. At 3:15 he set a clear meeting plan (he comes down the right side, Priya comes up from the bottom, shout when close) and asked Maya to check the joint. This closes the risk I flagged last visit. Ask him afterwards whether he held back at the end as Priya asked.

Priya: Spoke for the first time, and it was strong. She gave clear progress updates at 3:30 and 3:45, said exactly where she was, and told Leo to hold so the last stretch wasn't laid twice. She carried her line round the lower tail and joined the gap. Good ownership and communication. Earlier silence was not disengagement.

Maya: I heard nothing from her this visit, and I didn't see her check the joint, though Leo asked her to. Ask her whether she did, and whether the crowded stretch at (29,10-12) is solid. Still unconfirmed that she builds rather than only coaches.

Tom: Silent again, with no direct evidence on this visit. Ask Leo what Tom helped with. Rate cautiously, and ask him directly for his view in the review."}
